{{Quote|The droids are hunting for survivors. They're cutting through!|The clone's last words.|<ref name="rm">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref>}}
A '''clone navigation officer''' was stationed in the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Triumphant/Legends|''Triumphant'']], and participated in the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|Battle of Abregado]] under command of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], after the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]], the [[Malevolence/Legends|Malevolence]], attacked three [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]], this [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] along with a fellow officer and the rest of the crew of the ''Triumphant'' were evacuated in [[Escape pod/Legends|life-pods]]. While they drifted through space, they briefly managed to make contact with Plo Koon's life-pod, but were then intercepted by a squadron of [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droids]] in a [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ship]] which opened up their pod and killed them.

==Behind the scenes==
This clone was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], the actor who portrays all of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the series.
